evals.prompt: Let's pair on this using XP: build the discount calculator in small tested increments.
evals.expected_output: One small task per cycle: plan, one failing test, minimal code, refactor, commit.
assertions: Picks ONE small task with what, why, how (acceptance criteria)
Writes one failing test, then minimal code to pass
Refactors while green and commits the increment
Explains approach and tradeoffs before coding and runs tests and lint after every change
Splits the task if a cycle exceeds about 30 minutes

evals.prompt: We finished two XP cycles. Give me the pairing outcome.
assertions: Starts with a verdict (features working, tests green, ready for review) and top 3 blockers
States code state (diffs staged or on branch, tests passing)
Names the next task or hands prioritization to the human

evals.prompt: Write me a quick one-off script to rename these 20 files.
evals.expected_output: One-off script with no iteration; XP overhead does not fit.
assertions: Does not run the XP test-first cycle
